name: GetDriveFiles
description: Retrieves files and folders from a specified SharePoint document library location using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: DrivePath
fields.label: Folder Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the folder you want to retrieve files and folders from. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFolder

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the retrieval operation, including the list of files and folders in the specified location and any error messages.
